name: Stampli
summary: Stampli is an AP platform that keeps invoice questions, comments and approvals attached to each invoice. Its pricing page shows no dollar amounts and offers a quote request. Invoices arrive by email, upload or vendor portal, and payments go out by ACH, check, virtual card or supported international methods, depending on configuration.

facts.text: Stampli's FAQ says invoices can enter by email, upload or the vendor portal, and that its Billy assistant can extract invoice data and suggest coding.
Stampli says invoices can be routed by entity, amount, department, vendor or custom rules.
The payments page lists ACH, paper check, virtual card and supported international payment methods, subject to product availability and configuration.
Stampli names QuickBooks, NetSuite, Sage Intacct, Microsoft Dynamics, Oracle Fusion, SAP and Acumatica among its ERP integrations.
The payments page states no fees for any payment method.

hiddenCosts: Payment fees are not published and are set through sales.
